exceptions.reason: Tailwind's sr-only utility clips to a 1px box on purpose so assistive technology reads the text while sighted users never see it. The clipping is the accessibility mechanism, not truncation.
The tab strip is a segmented control: triggers sit flush inside one shared surface so the group reads as a single unit. An 8px gap would break the control.
InfoTooltip buttons already render a real hover/focus tooltip through Reka UI; the tooltip element only exists in the DOM while open, so a static check cannot see it.
Switches sit inside a label with their visible text next to them, so an extra tooltip would duplicate the label that is already on screen.

These are single-line tool invocations that must render verbatim, so the block scrolls horizontally instead of wrapping. The text is --foreground #171717 on the cream canvas, 17.5:1, far above AA; the check cannot resolve the background only because the scroll container clips part of the run.
